metric_definitions.hit@k: fraction of queries with direct-answer evidence in the top k
metric_definitions.recall@k: mean fraction of direct-answer chunks found in the top k
metric_definitions.mrr@10: mean reciprocal rank of the first direct-answer chunk, capped at 10
metric_definitions.ndcg@10: graded ranking quality using relevance 3 for direct and 1 for supporting chunks
